item.text:
The group analysis **did not find whole-brain corrected support for a positive vmPFC gain effect**. No significant positive voxels overlapped the vmPFC ROI. Its mean estimate was near zero, with a 95% confidence interval spanning both signs; this does not establish that the effect is absent.

The 54 maps produced 24 corrected positive voxels in three small posterior clusters. No participants were excluded.
